_doc: Settings for the automatic pipeline. Edit freely; every workflow reads this file at run time.
_slots: Posting times (Madrid). One reel per slot: two a day. A reel approved after its slot goes out as soon as it is approved, until publish_until.
_cover_style: Cover finish (pipeline/cover.py STYLES): A veil · B long veil · C frosted veil · D long veil, tight close-up · E warm frosted, tight close-up.
_nude_safe_framing: true = nudes are shown only in close-ups (YouTube may age-restrict them). Set false once Gigi confirms the Rokeby Venus Short was not restricted.
_learning_platforms: Platforms whose numbers the learning loop reads and judges. YouTube only since 6 Nov 2026 (Gigi: what works on YouTube is the key; the other apps are noise).
